raw_segments.text: Gratiano, O be thou damned, inexecrable dog, and for thy life let justice be accused, thou
almost maxed me waver in my faith, to hold opinion with Pythagoras that souls of animals
infuse themselves into the trunks of men.
Thy courage spirit governed a wolf who, hanged for human slaughter, even from the gallows
did his fell soul fleet, and whilst thou layest in thy unhallowed dam, enfust itself in thee.
For thy desires are wolfish, bloody, starved, and ravenous.
